name: claude-mods
description: Seven everyday mods for Claude Code: cost meter, safety net, changes pane, notifier, prompt booster, journal and secrets redactor.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Status line with context %, session cost and rate limits; warns before you hit the wall.

plugins.name: safety-net
plugins.description: Blocks catastrophic shell commands and asks before risky ones or edits to secret files.

plugins.name: changes-pane
plugins.description: A live pane listing every file Claude changed this session, with +/- line counts.

plugins.name: done-notifier
plugins.description: Chime, toast and desktop notification when a long turn finishes or Claude needs you.

plugins.name: prompt-booster
plugins.description: Adds repo context to short prompts, plus one-word commands for common tasks.

plugins.name: session-journal
plugins.description: Logs what you did with Claude across sessions; /journal and an AI-written /standup.

plugins.name: secrets-redactor
plugins.description: Scrubs API keys, tokens and private keys from prompts and tool output before the model sees them.
